issue: `_single_voice_refusal` is one function with two unrelated rule bodies, switched on `batch_id`; any non-`decision-gate` id falls into the tail-sweep rule. Two small predicates, one per call site, would be clearer. The 🟡/⚪ literals also repeat the `_DECISION_SEVERITY` keys; a `_MEDIUM_OR_LOW` constant beside `_ABOVE_MEDIUM` would be tidier.

Single-voice is defined by `[1/N]`/`found_by < 2` with no check on `total_agents`. In a lane with one reviewer (`[1/1]`), every Medium or Low is discarded or refused, so it can never become a task. The PRD does not carve this out, so confirm it is intended.

The Select sentence deviates from the spec text in three ways. `[1/N]` is not in backticks, "discarded" is not in backticks, and the arrow is `->` where the spec has `→`. It also adds a second, redundant "Zero ... skip the sweep" sentence next to the existing "Zero actionable Medium/Low" one.

The decision-gate check matches only the emoji severities 🟡 and ⚪. A hand-built row whose severity is the word "medium" or "low" bypasses `single_voice_fix`, and `_findings_refusal` may not catch it. The PRD says only the emoji, so this is a note, not a deviation.
The tail-sweep refusal reason names `ref or file`, where the PRD says "naming the first offending `ref`". It is equivalent when `ref` is present.
